notes.title: V.22.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes to the leaderboard[/h1]
This update will change the leaderboard server and the way the game saves/loads data, because maintaining the old server has become too expensive.

The new version will fix some bugs and add some improvements for all games in the Barro series.

Unfortunately, the old times will not be transferred to the new server due to the modifications that were made, also because of a bug that I ended up finding that allowed better times to be achieved on some occasions. For these reasons, all leaderboards have been reset. Sorry.

notes.title: V.19.0 [Barro Series]
notes.content:
In this new version of the Barro series you get a new plugin to handle inputs. (It's the same plugin that runs in games like The Long Dark.)

This will give you more options for configuring the inputs and will also make it possible to choose which controller the player wants to play with. (Before the controller defined the player)

I'm still integrating the plugin into the game and improvements are yet to be made, as well as a more appropriate translation for the game.

*If you notice something wrong with the new update, please use the game's forum to report it, thanks.

notes.title: Barro Series V.13
notes.content:
The Barro series will be updated to a new version (V.13). In this new version we will have a new UI and a new version of the leaderboard.

In case you still want to play the old version, open the Steam client and go to Properties>Betas and select the old_version branch.


* You can now select a flag for you on the leaderboard.
* All games from the series will be updated.

notes.title: V.2021.7.0 / V.2021.8.0
notes.content:
[h1]V.2021.7.0[/h1]

Small change for the bots, they will have less force to push you and it will be easier for you to push them.

Let me know if it gets better to race against the bots, thanks.



[h1]V.2021.8.0[/h1]

Changes in the cameras and the steering, it will be more like the first version of Barro since people seems to like that version better.

PS.: Barro Racing has 3 cameras, the default is the far one but, you can choose a different one if you like.

notes.title: V.2021.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]New version with some new stuff and improvements:[/h1]

ːns_greenː Improved menu

ːns_greenː Rearview mirror

ːns_greenː New cameras 

ːns_greenː New options for split screen (Options->Audio/Video)

ːns_greenː New option for steering help. If you deactivate it, it will give you a better control if you are playing with a controller or a steering wheel. (Options->Controls)

ːns_greenː Improved car controller

ːns_greenː New leaderboard lap-by-lap. Now you can fight for your position every lap. (The old leaderboard is still available in the old version)

ːns_greenː 2 new race tracks


[b]Note 1:[/b] You can check the key bindings for the new functions on Options->Controls

[b]Note 2:[/b] There is a new leaderboard for the new version but, you can still play the old version with your old scores.

[b]Note 3:[/b] To play the old version you will have to go to the games options on Steam cliente, go to the Betas tab and select the options "old_version - Old Version". 

[b]Note 4:[/b]  [Known bug] Sometimes your car may make a sharp turn to the side, if that happens, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1307090/discussions/]please let me know[/url].

[b]Note 5:[/b]  [Known bug] The camera sometimes is not smooth enough while turning the car and it will look like you have lag but, this is just the camera not being smooth enough. I am still working on it to make it better.
